notes: ὅτι is unrepresented under rule 43: the ASV punctuates the clause as direct speech and supplies no complementizer.

Παρά takes the whole two-word prepositional expression 'contrary to', headed on 'contrary'; splitting 'to' onto the article would leave a bare case preposition on it, which rule 21 forbids, and the article keeps its own 'the'.
οὗτος → 'This man' heads on the demonstrative under rule 17's generic-noun clause; two further articles are unrepresented under rule 23, the ASV writing no determiner for 'men' or 'God'.
